title: Llama 3.1 Public Release
summary: Meta announced and publicly released the Llama 3.1 model collection on July 23, 2024. The release included 8B, 70B, and 405B models, expanded context length to 128K, and added support across eight languages.
significance: A dated public-release milestone in the Llama model family, including the 405B model and upgraded 8B and 70B variants.
